snippet.title: Cubixx PSP minis trailer
snippet.description:
Classic action puzzle gaming brought into the 3rd dimension.
Cubixx is an old school test of skill, requiring lightning reflexes and split second decisions.
Evade or annihilate deadly enemies as you attempt to destroy faces of the cube, unleashing the energy within.
